sources.title: BART Model for Text Auto Completion in NLP - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BART's primary task is used to generate clean semantically coherent text from corrupted text data but it can also be used for a variety of different NLP sub-tasks like language translation, question-answering tasks, text summarization, paraphrasing, etc. As BART is an autoencoder model, it consists of an encoder model and a decoder model.
